technicalNotes:
This fault is NOT to be ignored Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: a major and/or critical system (Airbag, ABS etc.). If you try to clear this fault, VCDS may tell you that there is an unexpected result or that the controller refused the command. This is normal since this specific fault can generally not be cleared.
When stored in other unimportant systems (Radio etc.) the general suggestion is to ignore it unless you notice functional limitations. Within the warranty period dealers are usually required to Değiştirin / Yenileyin: such Kontrol Modülüs, but there have been a couple of cases with similar codes where these are getting ignored due to flaws in the Kontrol Modülü software. If in doubt please refer to technical bulletins and similar documents provided by the vehicle manufacturer.
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: Audi Airbag Generation 6 & 7 (see Audi TPI 1308401):
A Problem with the Acceleration Sensör Okuma Değerleri may result in the Airbag Kontrol Modülü storing this Fault Code. Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  the Airbag Kontrol Modülü and both Acceleration Sensör Okuma Değerleris.
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: Audi Airbag Generation 8:
Due to low Voltage the Kontrol Modülü does not complete it's Self Test successfully. Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Airbag Kontrol Modülü and install a low Voltage Protection Relay to ensure future mishaps won't cause this again. UPDATE The Protection Relay may not be available anymore, though the Parts Catalog lists updated Kontrol Modülüs now.
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: certain older TDI Engine Kontrol Modülüs (ECM) which have a vacuum line going to them:
Kontrol edin: /Repair the Vacuum Line before and inside the ECM.
